description: Entity counts the live subgraph must reproduce at the survey head (docs/specs/04-subgraph.md R17, R18). Queried with block: {number: 25884405}. Values marked exact come from the research archive; values marked expected are own inference from it and are confirmed or corrected at capture (02 R19 policy: differences are investigated and recorded, not patched in). Extension E1 (OpenEden, Ondo, Superstate) counts are derived from the raw evidence files of 2026-09-02 at head 25,885,411 and reduced to block 25,884,405 by the last event blocks.

feeds.note: 60 Midas, OpenEden, Ondo, Superstate, Hashnote, 4 Backed, 2 Centrifuge, 20 Chainlink proxies (POSTED); svZCHF, sUSDe, sUSDS, stUSDS, sDAI (DERIVED). Tectonic TONIC (Cronos) is unindexed by design.

rounds_unknown.note: every Safe-routed round is attributed by the setter call handlers; 215 if call handlers are disabled (feeds.json callHandlers false); OpenEden, Ondo and Superstate add none (their setters are call-handled)
